dataset: Felidae Conservation Fund 2020–2025, public LILA metadata
list_construction: In the full-list condition, every arm uses the same dataset-wide 64-name list. The narrow condition uses eleven names ranked by distinct-image frequency across all locations in metadata captured on or before 2025-03-19, with alphabetical tie-breaking and display order. Its scored subset consists of sampled later crops whose reference species is in those eleven names. No-list conditions omit the option list.
score: Mean recall across present classes within each source location, averaged equally across locations; strict and taxonomy-lenient rules are fixed.

paired_rows.interval_method: Percentile bootstrap of paired whole-location differences in class-balanced accuracy; the classes present in each cohort remain fixed.

limitations: List length, contents and answer positions change together; the comparison does not isolate a universal list-length limit.
Training-data membership is unpublished. The capture-date rule cannot certify that images were absent from training.
The recorded accuracy applies to this manifest, separately from published SpeciesNet accuracy.
This regional experiment requires a separate manifest and evaluation from the supplied 1,611-crop kit.
The comparison does not separate response-format and animal-recognition effects.

information_conditions.speciesnet_with_list: The shared regional allowed set replaces geographic filtering. These results use that restricted classifier rather than the default ensemble.
information_conditions.speciesnet_no_list: SpeciesNet uses native USA/California geographic priors. VLM no-list arms receive no geographic prior.
information_conditions.siglip_no_list: SigLIP selects from a finite, frozen text dictionary.
information_conditions.reference_standard: All arms classify the same MegaDetector v5a-selected crops against dataset-provider annotations. Detection accuracy is outside this measurement.
